bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
echo GAYBBS_HELP_PREFLIGHT_V2
printf 'CHECKOUT='; pwd
printf 'REPO_HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'REPO_BRANCH='; git branch --show-current
printf 'DIRTY_TRACKED='; git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no | wc -l
printf 'HELP_EXISTS='; if test -f artifacts/bot/src/bot/operationHelpHandlers.ts;then echo YES;else echo NO;fi
echo DEPLOY_PATHS
for p in production-start.sh artifacts/bot/Dockerfile artifacts/bot/deploy/compose.yaml artifacts/bot/deploy/docker-compose.yml deploy/compose.yaml docker-compose.yml;do test ! -e "$p" || echo "$p";done
echo GAYBBS_CONTAINERS
docker ps --format '{{.Names}}|{{.Image}}|{{.Status}}' | grep -Ei 'gaybbs|gateapp|tg[t]?umbler' || true
echo READ_ONLY_DONE
